---
title: "PDF Export of Slides"
---

If you want to print the lecture slides, you can export them to PDF using the following instructions:

1. Open the slides in full screen more. 
2. Toggle into Print View using the `E` key (or using the Navigation Menu). 
3. Change the Destination setting to Save as PDF.
4. Change the Layout to Landscape.
5. Change the Margins to None.
6. Enable the Background graphics option.
7. Click Save

*Note: This feature has only been confirmed to work in Google Chrome and Chromium.*
